Records: every record has warmup=false, outcome.status=verified, matches_target=true, matches_planted=true, a numeric .workload.planted in [1, r-1], recovered == planted, cost.deterministic=true, r = 1883199430181 throughout; cost.s == cost.total_gae / sqrt(r) exactly on every record. One planted scalar per (session, target_index) across all curves of both sides (planted_shared).

Recomputation agreement: all 108 compared values (side runs, side means, G, 14 level means and 7 per-level G per arm, band S1/S2/ratio at w = 0, 0.1, 1, for rho-neg, rho-neg-aa, bsgs-neg; run totals) are bit-identical to analysis.json (relative difference 0): my awk sums run in record-file order, evidently the same order as volcano-stats. No rel_tol had to be widened.

Planted controls: plant-up b_over_a = 1.0455511639841288 vs 1.05 x G = 1.0455511639841326 (rel 3.6e-15), plant-down 0.945974862652311 vs 0.95 x G = 0.94597486265231046 (rel 5.9e-16); the residual is rounding of applying the factor per run before summing; applying 1.05 / 0.95 per run reproduces both claimed values to the last digit. Claimed: plant-up 95% CI [1.01556, 1.07744], perm_p 0.0040; plant-down 95% CI [0.91884, 0.97482], perm_p 0.0006; both exclude 1 with p < 0.05.

Independent bootstrap / permutation (awk, own RNG, seed 777/778; curves = vertices resampled within (side, level), all 12 runs each; labels permuted among curves of each level; 4000 / 10000): rho-neg 90% [0.97131, 1.02100], 95% [0.96679, 1.02545], p 0.781 (claimed 90% [0.97135, 1.02049], 95% [0.96627, 1.02566], p 0.783); rho-neg-aa 95% [0.95157, 1.04867], p 0.993 (claimed [0.95246, 1.05259], p 0.991); plant-up 95% [1.01534, 1.07646], p 0.0036; plant-down 95% [0.91755, 0.97356], p 0.0002. Monte Carlo agreement only (different RNG); not in headline.

BSGS exactness: across all 380 curves of BOTH sides, each target_index has exactly one cost.s value (t0: 0.5465048204102515, total_gae 749967; t1: 0.70866867991291782, total_gae 972504). analysis.json's max_distinct_cost_per_target=1 with paired_targets=4 is keyed by (side, target), i.e. within-side only; the cross-side identity the protocol states is established by this recomputation, not by the producer's statistic.

Band: ecbench band --dir run/sessions/spec (validation/band-spec.json, 760 per-curve rows, all 6/6 verified, no uncounted) agrees with my per-curve means at w = 0, 0.1, 1 to <= 5.2e-16 relative; its per-curve factor S(w=1)/S(w=0) matches mine to <= 4.4e-16 and lies in [1.99933, 1.99981] (canonicalisations_uncharged ~= total_gae). The side ratio is 0.995763, 0.995763, 0.995762 at w = 0, 0.1, 1: same method on both sides, reported, not ranked.

Independent curve checks (bc): all 760 models: G on curve, 4a^3+27b^2 != 0, j = 1728*4a^3/(4a^3+27b^2) equals the exported j, [n]G = O, [#E]G = O. Deterministic Miller-Rabin (12 bases; controls 561 and 3215031751 composite, 1e9+7 prime): p, n, N prime. #E = p+1-t = 2388 n; t^2-4p = -11 (2^6 N)^2; n^2 > 16p; t+2 = 0 mod N; N = 9 mod 11; N^2 | p+1+t. Per side 190 vertices with level counts [1,3,6,12,24,48,96], 190 distinct j per side, 0 shared between sides, both models of a vertex share j.

Side certificates: volcano-gap certify --seed 777: all_ok true, 760 models, 0 failed, distinct_j [190,190], j shared 0; S1 380 twist_n_rank 2, S2 380 rank 1 with witness; all 380 S2 witnesses differ from the producer's seed. Independently in bc (twist y^2 = x^3 + 9a x + 27b, c = 3 a non-residue; own deterministic points, Tonelli-Shanks): S1 all 380 models, 3/3 points killed by [#E^t/N] (consistent with (Z/N)^2; a cyclic N-part would pass with probability <= N^-3); S2 all 380 models, 3/3 points with [#E^t/N]R != O (N-part cyclic, proved), producer witnesses on the twist and non-zero; [#E^t]R = O for every point. method_detail: jq flattens records (.workload.curve_spec p,a,b,gx,gy; .cost.s; .cost.total_gae; sum of .counters named in .cost.unpriced) and curves.jsonl to TSV; awk joins on (p,a,b,gx,gy) as exact decimal strings and computes means, ratios, per-level means and the section 5a band S(w) = mean of cost.s*(1 + w*U/cost.total_gae); GNU bc for elliptic-curve, primality and twist checks; awk bootstrap/permutation for interval cross-checks. No producer script or volcano-stats output was used to compute any recomputed value.
